risks.title: Construction Lending Risk
risks.score_rationale: Construction loans are subject to losses due to project delays, cost overruns, or sales difficulties in the California real estate market (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Construction loans carry elevated risk due to potential project delays, unforeseen cost increases, or market sales challenges

risks.title: Real Estate Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: Decline in real estate values and cash flows can result in loan losses and asset impairments held by the bank (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Declines in real estate values and cash flows may lead to loan losses and reduced collateral values for the bank's portfolio

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk of borrower defaults and resulting loan losses, particularly in construction and real estate segments (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Borrower defaults can result in significant loan losses across the portfolio

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk of insufficient liquidity to meet deposit withdrawals or credit demands in stressed market conditions (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Inadequate liquidity may impair the bank's ability to meet deposit withdrawals and fulfill credit requests

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Changes in banking regulations by DFPI, FDIC, or federal authorities may increase compliance costs and restrict operations (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Regulatory changes may increase compliance costs and affect the bank's operational flexibility

risks.title: Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in financial markets can result in investment losses and impact portfolio valuations (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Market volatility may result in losses on securities and investment holdings

risks.title: Competitive Risk
risks.score_rationale: Increased competition from larger banks and fintech firms may erode market share in served communities (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Competitive pressures may result in loss of market share and margin compression
